title: Vienna Game: Vienna Gambit
line: The King's Gambit idea with a knight already out. Black strikes back in the center.

steps.text: The Vienna Game: Black brings its knight out to attack your pawn on e4.
Push the pawn on f2 two squares. It attacks the pawn on e5.

also.f1c4: That is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn.
also.g1f3: That is also played. This lesson pushes the pawn.

steps.after: This is the Vienna Gambit, rated about level by engines and played often by masters. Black strikes back in the center.

steps.text: Take the pawn on e5. Your pawn then attacks the knight.
steps.after: The knight jumps into the center and takes your pawn.

steps.text: Bring your other knight out. It guards the pawn on e5.

also.d1f3: That is also played. This lesson brings the knight out.

steps.text: Push the pawn in front of your queen two squares. Two pawns stand side by side.

also.d1e2: That is also played. This lesson builds the center.

steps.text: Bring the bishop out to attack the knight on e4.
steps.after: Black guards the knight with a pawn that has moved two squares, landing beside your pawn on e5.

steps.text: Take that pawn en passant: your pawn on e5 takes it as if it had moved one square.
steps.after: Material is level, and the center is open.

steps.text: Castle. Your king leaves the open center, and the rook comes to a file with no white pawn on it.
steps.after: An open game with chances for both sides. Your pawn on d4 holds the center.

summary: White pushes the side pawn with the knight already out. Black hits back in the center and the game opens up.
